title.narrative: Strengthening EU Collaboration to Uncover and Resist Emerging Corruption (SECURE)

description.narrative: (i) To enhance EU-level actions against corruption to address the current andevolving security threats that corruption poses to citizens and the licit economy and (ii) To support the work carried out by Member States’ competent authorities and otherstakeholders in the prevention of and fight against corruption.Partnership: TI-S would like to bring in another DG HOME grantee, Transcrime (https://transcrime.it/kleptotrace)Added value of Transcrime: Transcrime brings several key advantages: i) data tools and development, ii) experience in working directly with law enforcement, and iii) bringing national authorities as co-applicants, which is highly encouraged by DG HOME. Transcrime was also a partner under DG FISMA. Value of the contract is 1.8 million Euros.

participating-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs (DG HOME)

recipient-region.narrative: Germany, Ireland, Slovakia, Hungary, Italy, Netherlands, Serbia, and Bulgaria
